name: At phone width the sticky days bar shows 26 days left and its Add trip button opens the trip sheet

planSteps.description: At 390x844, navigate to /?today=2026-10-19&fresh=1 and click 'Try an example'
Scroll down: the phone days bar (data-testid=mobile-days-bar) is visible and reads 26 days left, the same as the status panel
Click the bar's Add trip button: the trip sheet (data-testid=trip-sheet) opens with the entry field
